features.title: Capture text clips
features.summary: Every text copy becomes a history entry with a short preview and the full body.

features.title: Capture image clips
features.summary: Images are stored with a thumbnail and served to the webview through a custom media URI scheme.

features.title: Capture copied file lists
features.summary: Explorer copies are decoded from the DROPFILES clipboard format and each path is listed in the detail pane.

features.title: Respect clipboard opt-out flags
features.summary: Copies marked with ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing, or with history or cloud upload disabled, are never captured.

features.title: Summon the overlay with a global hotkey
features.summary: Alt+V by default, configurable in settings with validation before the shortcut is registered.

features.title: Tray menu and background operation
features.summary: Tray icon toggles the overlay and exposes open, clear unpinned history, settings and quit.

features.title: Enforce a single running instance
features.summary: Launching again raises the running window instead of adding a second tray icon and hotkey.

features.title: Closing hides instead of quitting
features.summary: The close button and Alt+F4 hide the window so the clipboard watcher keeps running; quitting stays in the tray menu.

features.title: Launch at login
features.summary: Optional startup registration that brings the watcher back after a reboot, still hidden.

features.title: Optionally hide when focus is lost
features.summary: Off by default so the window behaves as an inspection surface; the overlay behaviour is opt-in.

features.title: Ranked search as you type
features.summary: Results rank by exact match, word boundaries, position and recency over an in-memory decrypted index.

features.title: De-duplicate clips and promote reuse
features.summary: Copying the same payload promotes the existing entry and the reused clip jumps back to the top.

features.title: Pin, collect and tag clips
features.summary: Pinned clips survive bulk clears, and collections plus tags group history without duplicating it.

features.title: Retention pruning and clear history
features.summary: Old clips are pruned by policy, and clearing history can keep pinned entries.

features.title: Preview text, images and file paths
features.summary: The detail pane shows the full text, the image, or every path before the clip is reused.

features.title: List and card layouts with interface scaling
features.summary: Rows for reading text, cards for browsing images, adjustable card size and a 70-200% text scale using CSS zoom.

features.title: Collapsible preview pane
features.summary: The detail pane collapses from its top-left chevron, giving the list or grid the full width.

features.title: Opt-in paste back into the foreground app
features.summary: Scope 2 pastes into the window that had focus before the overlay opened, using scan codes so raw-input apps work too.

features.title: Encrypt clip payloads at rest
features.summary: A DPAPI-wrapped data key seals preview, body and file columns with AES-256-GCM under a fresh nonce per record.

features.title: Per-user NSIS installer
features.summary: No elevation prompt, an Apps & features entry, and app data kept outside the install directory.

features.title: Setting page dynamic search
features.summary: A search box at the top of the settings page narrows the page as you type; name matches rank above description matches, and a matching section heading keeps all of its rows.

features.title: Draggable card-size slider
features.summary: The tile view's -/+ zoom buttons are replaced by a draggable slider that applies the card size when the drag ends.

features.title: Configurable clip storage location
features.summary: The data folder can be chosen in settings; moving it copies the database, media and key, restarts, and removes the old copy.

features.title: Gear-style settings icon
features.summary: The sun-like title bar glyph was replaced with a proper gear outline.

features.title: Themes with color pickers
features.summary: Dark and light presets plus a custom mode with a swatch and hex field per color token; palettes are applied as CSS custom properties.

features.title: Collection hover actions no longer overlap the count
features.summary: The clip count hides while a collection's hover actions are shown, so archive and delete no longer sit on top of it.

features.title: Archive collections
features.summary: Collections can be archived: their clips leave the history views and search, survive clear-history and retention, and return when unarchived.

features.title: Retention by hours or days
features.summary: The maximum age can be expressed in hours or days, and archived clips are exempt from every retention limit.

features.title: Copy button in list and card views
features.summary: Hovering a row or card reveals a copy button that copies without hiding the window, unlike Enter or double click.

features.title: Search covers tag names
features.summary: Tag names are folded into the in-memory search index, so a clip filed under #invoice turns up for "invoice" even when its body never says the word.

features.title: Confirmation before deleting a collection
features.summary: Deleting a collection opens a confirmation dialog that spells out that the clips themselves are kept.

features.title: Order by dropdown in the history views
features.summary: The toolbar offers last-used or capture-date ordering in either direction; pinned clips stay on top and search relevance still wins while typing.

features.title: Remove the Enter-copies hint from the status bar
features.summary: The bottom bar no longer claims what Enter does; it keeps the clip count, storage use, encryption state and hotkey.

features.title: Searchable text in screenshots
features.summary: Images are read in the background with the built-in Windows OCR engine and the recognised text is encrypted, indexed for search, shown in the detail pane, and copyable from a hover button on the card.

features.title: Settings toggles stay inside their pill when zoomed
features.summary: The switch knob is centred with flexbox and clipped by the track, so fractional rounding at non-100% interface scales can no longer push it outside.

features.title: Auto-update from GitHub releases
features.summary: A signed in-place updater checks the latest GitHub release once a day (toggleable in settings), shows an install banner, downloads with progress and relaunches; a tag-triggered workflow builds and publishes the signed artefacts.

features.title: Card size resizes live while dragging
features.summary: The grid follows a local scale while the slider moves and the setting is written after the gesture pauses, so thumbnails resize under the pointer.

features.title: Per-category default view
features.summary: Every history category keeps its own list/cards choice, configurable in Appearance; images default to cards and everything else to rows.

features.title: Reveal clips and archives in Explorer
features.summary: Right-clicking a clip reveals its stored image or original file/folder; right-clicking an archive opens its dedicated folder under archives/, which follows renames and disappears when empty.

features.title: Always on Top setting preference
features.summary: Settings → Window → Always on top keeps the overlay above other applications; off by default and applied at startup as well as immediately when toggled.

features.title: Recognise color codes as swatches
features.summary: A payload that is entirely a hex or rgb()/rgba() value is recognised as a color: cards, rows and the preview pane paint the sample with the copied code overlaid, and a dedicated Colors view lists them.

features.title: Pause capture with a private mode
features.summary: A tray menu, a second global hotkey and a settings row pause clipboard capture for 15 minutes, an hour, or until restart; the watcher ignores changes while paused and the status bar shows a resume chip.

features.title: Quick-paste slots with Ctrl+1-9
features.summary: Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 copy the matching visible result without moving the selection, auto-pasting when that setting is on; rows and cards show their slot number.

features.title: Auto-clear the clipboard after use
features.summary: Optionally empties the Windows clipboard a configurable time after a copy, or as soon as the overlay hides, and leaves it alone if anything else was copied in the meantime.

features.title: Manage tags from the sidebar
features.summary: A right-click menu on a tag renames it, merges it into an existing tag, paints it with a color shown in the sidebar, or deletes it from every clip, and the search index is refreshed either way.

features.title: Save clips to disk
features.summary: Save as... writes a clip into a folder of your choosing: the stored PNG for images, copies of the original files for file lists, and the text (plus an HTML copy when present) for text clips, with unique names.

features.title: Include archived clips in search
features.summary: An Archives toggle in the search bar and an in:archive operator let a query reach clips filed in archive collections, which stay hidden from ordinary searches.

features.title: Multi-select with bulk actions
features.summary: Ctrl/Shift-click and Ctrl+A pick several clips, and a bulk bar pins, tags, files into a collection, or deletes the whole selection through new backend bulk commands.

features.title: Search operators and saved searches
features.summary: kind:, type:, app:, tag:, collection:, before:, pinned:, color: and in:archive are parsed from the search box and shown as removable chips; any query can be saved to the sidebar as a smart view.

features.title: Content-aware actions for recognised clips
features.summary: Color recognition now also classifies links, email addresses, Windows paths and JSON, and the preview pane and context menu offer matching actions: open a link, open or reveal a path, pretty-print JSON.

features.title: Drag clips into other applications
features.summary: Rows and cards can be dragged out of the overlay: text travels as text/plain, images and file lists as text/uri-list, with the payload pre-loaded on hover so the drop lands immediately.

features.title: Rich-text capture and paste as plain text
features.summary: CF_HTML and RTF are captured next to the plain body, stored encrypted in their own columns, and written back on copy so a styled clip pastes styled; a setting turns it off to paste plain text only.

features.title: Tag Filter
features.summary: A filter box under the Tags heading narrows the sidebar tag list as you type; Enter jumps to the first match and Esc clears it.

features.title: Utilities section with an emoji browser
features.summary: A new Utilities sidebar section opens a searchable emoji browser: click copies an emoji, right-click adds it to Favourites (shown first) or removes it from Favourites while leaving it in the library.

features.title: Bulk collect with a new collection name
features.summary: Typing a new collection name in the bulk Collect prompt creates the collection and files the selection into it, instead of sending a null collection id that the backend rejected.

features.title: Properties sidebar in card view
features.summary: The preview pane is shown in both layouts, so tags, collections, the archive slot and the full preview are reachable without switching to the list.

features.title: Resizable properties sidebar
features.summary: The pane's left edge is a drag handle: width is clamped to a usable 200 px minimum and 80% of the window, and the chosen width is stored in the settings.

features.title: Recognise bare hex and CSS Color 4 rgb()
features.summary: Hex without a hash (ff8800, 0xFF8800, f80) and space-separated or slash-alpha rgb() values are recognised, with a digit-and-letter test so words like facade and numbers like 123456 are not mistaken for colors.

features.title: Export multiple selected items
features.summary: A Save to... action in the bulk bar writes every selected clip into one chosen folder, keeping unique names and reporting how many files were written.

features.title: Collections and archives are separate areas
features.summary: The pane splits Collections (stackable, multi-select) from Archive (a single radio slot), and the backend now keeps archive membership out of set_clip_collections so ticking a collection can never unarchive a clip.

features.title: Emoji browser performance
features.summary: The emoji browser now opens on a single category and renders rows virtually, so the first paint builds ~100 buttons instead of the whole library; opening dropped from ~570 ms to ~75 ms, searching no longer re-renders every entry, and category chips switch sections instantly.

features.title: Use "Color" spelling throughout the app
features.summary: Every user-facing string, identifier, comment and doc uses the American "color" spelling: the sidebar entry, the tag menu and dialog, the settings labels, the content-kind label and the README.

features.summary: Allow the error messages to be copied when the application has a problem, currently you can't select them.
